name: Signing Outside the Studio
description: The goal of this work is background-robust continuous sign language recognition. Most existing Continuous Sign Language Recognition (CSLR) benchmarks have fixed backgrounds and are filmed in studios with a static monochromatic background. However, signing is not limited only to studios in the real world. In order to analyze the robustness of CSLR models under background shifts, we first evaluate existing state-of-the-art CSLR models on diverse backgrounds. To synthesize the sign videos with a variety of backgrounds, we propose a pipeline to automatically generate a benchmark dataset utilizing existing CSLR benchmarks. Our newly constructed benchmark dataset consists of diverse scenes to simulate a real-world environment. We observe even the most recent CSLR method cannot recognize glosses well on our new dataset with changed backgrounds. In this regard, we also propose a simple yet effective training scheme including (1) background randomization and (2) feature disentanglement for CSLR
reputation: A specialized benchmark for continuous sign language recognition robustness under background shift, mainly used in CSLR research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; constructed by synthesizing varied backgrounds onto existing CSLR data; evaluates robustness rather than standard in-studio performance.
